text:
maria: Heads up — we need to finalize the marketplace pricing + joint launch plan with Atlas Hardware. Main Q: do we push a single private-offer SKU with committed spend ladder or tiered discounts by usage?

sanjay: single SKU + ladder feels simpler for billing and renewals. less friction for SI quoting.

liz: worried about customer perception — large prospects expect visible discount tiers. can we show floor + accelerator?

jon: proposal: public list price for Marketplace, private-offer that maps to 1) 12mo commit floor, 2) 24mo ladder with accelerator credits, 3) optional SI-integration credit bundle. keeps UI simple.

ash: +1 on optional SI credits. need finance to sign off on how credits consume committed spend. finance-bot: POLICY CHECK: SI credit redemption reduces committed consumption up to 20% of quarter spend; approvals required.

liz: does that mean SI credits will count against the customer commit and reduce usage metrics? that's a hard ask for sales ops.

maria: That would complicate renewals. Alternative: make SI credits off-commit (i.e., delivered as professional services coupons) so they don't reduce committed revenue.

jon: If off-commit, Atlas legal will push for minimums on coupon usage window. timeline risk for launch.

ash: timeline-wise partner marketing wants joint announcement in 6 weeks. we need SKU and private-offer template 3 weeks prior to announcement to give marketplace listing team time.

liz: legal checklist: export controls for hardware-adjacent offers, data residency note for private offers in GovCloud — flagging.

maria: action items: 1) product to confirm private-offer ladder parameters (liz + jon) 2) finance to confirm credit accounting and give approval threshold (ash + finance-bot) 3) partnerships to draft co-announcement milestones (maria + devrel-sam).

jon: ladder draft suggestion: tier A = $250k/yr -> 15% off, tier B = $750k/yr -> 22% off, tier C = $1.5M+ -> 30% off + 50% SI credit up to $200k. open to tweaks.

ash: can we cap accelerator at 6 months usage credit to prevent long tail?

liz: yes cap makes sense. also need renewal protection language — after commit term, reprice to list if not renewed within 30 days.

maria: good. assign owners: liz (legal & product wording), jon (SKU + private-offer config), ash (finance rebate mechanics), devrel-sam (announce timeline & co-marketing assets).

devrel-sam: I can draft a 2-week campaign schedule and sample co-email. ping me if you want the template: I'll reuse from last Marketplace launch.

maria: one more — partner ops: Atlas wants hardware bundle discount when customer brings their own infra. we need a BYOH clause in the offer.

jon: add BYOH as optional add-on that reduces discount by 5% but qualifies for faster provisioning. need ops sign-off.

maria: ok will loop in partner-ops. final ask: everyone post a quick +1 or concerns by EOD Friday so we can lock the private-offer SKU by Monday. :thumbsup:

sanjay: +1

liz: +1 (pending legal wording)

ash: +1 (pending finance confirmation)

devrel-sam: +1

maria: thanks — I'll collate and schedule the sync with Atlas for Tuesday.
